name: conductor
description: Conducts a larger piece of work in Claude Code: a live run board, a model router for worker agents, board messaging, context rotation, and a merge loop: GitHub pull requests pinned to the checked head, or Lore branches merged into the base only on your approval. Tickets from GitHub or Linear.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: A token that can read checks and merge pull requests in your repositories. Leave it empty to use GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or the token of gh auth login.

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: A Linear API key for runs whose tickets are in Linear. Leave it empty to use LINEAR_API_KEY.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The branch a run's pull requests merge into.

mergeMethod.title: Merge method
mergeMethod.description: How GitHub merges a run's pull requests.

loreBin.title: Lore program
loreBin.description: The full path of the lore program, for a Lore workspace where it is neither on the PATH nor in ~/.local/bin. Leave it empty to look there, or set LORE_BIN.

trustedRoots.title: Trusted folders
trustedRoots.description: Absolute folders, separated by ':' or ',', outside your home folder where a folder home may also lie, e.g. a work volume you own. Leave it empty to accept a folder home only inside your home folder.
